∀ (H : BfgsVerification.Mat 2) (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec 2),
  BfgsVerification.dot y s ≠ 0 →
    BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y =
      (BfgsVerification.dot (BfgsVerification.PlanarUpdate.perp s)
              (Matrix.mulVec H (BfgsVerification.PlanarUpdate.perp s)) /
            BfgsVerification.dot y s ^ 2) •
          BfgsVerification.outer (BfgsVerification.PlanarUpdate.perp y) (BfgsVerification.PlanarUpdate.perp y) +
        (BfgsVerification.dot y s)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer s s

∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ {g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      g ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {α : ℝ},
          0 < α →
            0 < BfgsVerification.dot y (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) →
              (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) y)⁻¹ =
                H⁻¹ - (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer g g +
                  (BfgsVerification.dot y (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α))⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer y y

BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.update
    (BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.update
      (BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.update 1 BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g0 BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g1 1)
      BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g1
      (BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g2 (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 0) (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 1))
      (1 / 4))
    (BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g2 (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 0) (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 1))
    BfgsVerification.SeedCycle.g0 (1 / 16) =
  BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.ratio (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 0) (BfgsVerification.AlgebraicSeed.root 1) •
    1

∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      BfgsVerification.dot y s ≠ 0 →
        Matrix.det (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y) =
          BfgsVerification.dot s (Matrix.mulVec H⁻¹ s) / BfgsVerification.dot y s * Matrix.det H

∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 < BfgsVerification.dot y s → Matrix.PosDef (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y)

∀ {n : ℕ} (H : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.dot y s ≠ 0 → Matrix.mulVec (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y) y = s

∀ {n : ℕ} {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    ∀ (s y : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      0 < BfgsVerification.dot y s → Matrix.mulVec (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s y)⁻¹ s = y
